source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 2016 official U.S. Senate canvass
source_notes: 2016 regular Arizona U.S. Senate election. All 11 official named candidates, including write-ins, and all 15 county records reconcile to the printed statewide canvass totals. Reviewed page-11 transcription from the retained official signed PDF, acquired from a pinned public mirror after the official host returned 403. All eleven missing one-vote glyphs in the hidden text layer were read from the visible page; no blank was interpreted as zero. Official page-1 turnout retained.
turnout_definition: Official canvass turnout: total ballots cast / total eligible registration; published rounded percentage retained.
